name: Code review (read-only)
description: No files are modified: overview, quality and security reviews in parallel, final report.
goalHint: Say what to review (folders, a module, recent changes such as 'git diff main') and what to focus on.

data.label: Overview
data.role: Analyst: reconstructs the structure and responsibilities of the code to review.
data.instructions: Reconstruct the structure of the part of the project named in the goal: modules, responsibilities, main dependencies, entry points. List the files most relevant to the review.

data.label: Quality and correctness
data.role: Reviewer: looks for bugs, unhandled edge cases and code that is hard to maintain.
data.instructions: Review the files listed in the overview. Report only concrete problems with file and line, severity and proposed fix: bugs, edge cases, error handling, duplication, misleading names.

data.label: Security
data.role: Security reviewer: looks for exploitable vulnerabilities, not style.
data.instructions: Review the files listed in the overview looking for vulnerabilities: unvalidated input, injection, secrets in the code, permissions, risky dependencies. For each one give file and line, an exploitation scenario and the fix.

data.label: Report
data.role: Editor: merges the results into a report ordered by priority.
data.instructions: Merge the findings of the reviews into a single report: remove duplicates, sort by severity, and for each item give file, problem and fix. Do not read other files except to check a doubt.
